list_child.name: ls_leg
list_child.desc: Returns every transport leg currently on file across all rescues, whether it is planned, in transit, delivered, or cancelled. This is the call to make when you need the full picture instead of a single leg.

get_child.name: get_leg
get_child.desc: Returns the full record for a single transport leg identified by its id. Use this once you already know which leg you need details on, rather than scanning the whole list.

list_parent.name: ls_rsc
list_parent.desc: Returns every partner rescue organization currently on file, including those with no legs currently scheduled. This is useful for looking up a rescue before creating or referencing a leg.

get_parent.name: get_rsc
get_parent.desc: Returns the full record for a single partner rescue organization identified by its id. Use this whenever you already have a rescue id and need its details.

delete_child.name: rm_leg
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a transport leg record from the system, and the action cannot be undone once it runs. This should only be used for legs entered in error, never for legs that were simply cancelled.

set_enum.name: set_leg_phs
set_enum.desc: Changes a transport leg's phase to planned, in_transit, delivered, or cancelled so the manifest reflects where the animal currently is. Use this any time a leg starts, finishes, or gets called off.

set_bool.name: flag_crate
set_bool.desc: Flags a transport leg as requiring a crate for the animal being moved, which drivers check before loading. This should be set whenever the receiving rescue specifies crate transport.

set_ref.name: mv_leg_rsc
set_ref.desc: Moves a transport leg onto a different partner rescue's manifest, which is useful when a leg was logged under the wrong organization. This does not change anything else recorded about the leg.

send.name: fax_rsc
send.desc: Sends a fax to a partner rescue organization's line on file, confirming a handoff or requesting updated paperwork. This remains the standard way many partner rescues prefer to be reached for transport coordination.
